title: No mechanism to correct a defective acceptance criterion mid-cycle: AC authoring defects burn all 3 review rounds and land MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT
description:
Structural finding from CAM-376 (PR #301), which reached MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT with a deliverable that was CORRECT in every round. The debt was entirely in the acceptance criteria, not in the code.

MEASURED: five of the nine criteria in that PRD were defective.
1. US-001 AC2 / US-002 AC6 froze the comparand as `-eq 3`, violating the derive-don't-freeze rule the same PR was shipping. It went red when a later story legitimately needed to name the path in prose.
2. US-001 AC3 was structurally vacuous: a `git check-ignore` loop over path tokens that, with zero tokens present, never entered the loop body and passed with zero iterations.
3. US-001 AC4 and US-003 AC3 targeted scripts/cam/handoff.json, a per-story ROTATING artifact, so they went green or red depending on which story's rotation happened to be at HEAD. AC4 read GREEN transiently at one point purely by coincidence of rotation.
4. US-003 AC1 (`! grep -q 'ms <= 1_000' test/dispatch.test.ts`) was a whole-file string prohibition, so it re-reddened the moment a later fix story DOCUMENTED the removed assertion verbatim in a durable source comment -- penalizing exactly the right behavior.

ROOT CAUSE: a review-fix story cannot repair a defective criterion. Write/Edit/MultiEdit on scripts/cam/prd.json is hard-blocked for CAM_WORKER=1 sessions by .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh. The worker's own handoff recorded this explicitly ('this story could not re-derive that comparand because Write/Edit/MultiEdit on scripts/cam/prd.json is hard-blocked'). The block itself is a CORRECT security boundary -- a worker must not rewrite its own grading rubric -- so the fix is NOT to relax it.

CONSEQUENCE: when the defect is in the criterion rather than the code, the loop's only remaining lever is to bend the DELIVERABLE until the defective oracle goes green. That happened here: a bullet was reworded to drop a prose path mention purely to satisfy a frozen `-eq 3`. The content survived via cross-reference so the damage was mild, but the incentive is backwards and the next occurrence may not be mild. It also produces a MISLEADING RECORD: the PRD on main reads as 'shipped with 2 unresolved CRITICALs' when both were criterion defects with a correct deliverable.

DIRECTIONS TO EVALUATE (none pre-chosen, this needs its own grounding pass):
(a) A supervisor-mediated AC amendment path: the worker proposes a retarget, the supervisor (not the worker) applies it, preserving the rubric boundary while making criteria correctable.
(b) Planner-side or auditor-side AC validation BEFORE dispatch: sweep every candidate oracle red-against-main and reject frozen comparands, ephemeral-artifact targets, and zero-match-vacuous shapes. The rules already exist in patterns.md (:899 falsifiability, :903 derive-don't-freeze, :907 no rotating-artifact targets); nothing enforces them.
(c) A distinct terminal verdict separating 'criterion defect' from 'code defect' so the record does not lie.

The residual gap is already documented durably at patterns.md:907, but nothing tracks fixing it. Related: CAM-379 (merit-over-cost rule for reviewer/auditor).

spec.scope: Enforce the three unenforced oracle-authoring rules at scripts/cam/patterns.md:901/:903/:907 BEFORE a PRD is dispatched, by extending the existing CAM-310 deterministic lint pipeline, and mirror the one rule that pipeline structurally cannot reach (:899 red-on-main falsifiability) into the auditor's existing acceptance-criteria section. This is direction (B) of CAM-381's three candidate directions, chosen after a measured grounding pass. Directions (A) supervisor-mediated mid-cycle AC amendment and (C) a distinct criterion-defect terminal verdict are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE here: (C) has no producer in the system (the reviewer regex at src/supervisor/review.ts:147 is a closed two-alternative union and the reviewer is read-only, the supervisor has no judgment) and its exact shape was refused twice in writing at .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md:157 and src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:756-757; (A) is blocked on a missing prerequisite (there is no prd.schema.json and acceptanceCriteria is a bare string[] in all three read-models, so an amendment could only target index-or-exact-string across exactly the rounds in which the supervisor rewrites that array) and on an unresolved ratification crux (finalizeStory is deterministic TS with no LLM, so mechanical application would preserve the letter of the worker-cannot-edit-its-own-rubric boundary while dissolving its substance). WORK 1, deterministic rules: add one OracleLintRule per statically-detectable class to the RULES array in src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts, which self-documents at its RULES declaration as one-liner-extensible and is already wired through runOracleLintCheck and buildLintBlockReport in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts into a synthetic BLOCK folded into the existing audit-BLOCK replan loop. Add NO new verdict, NO new terminal kind, and NO new wiring: the entire value of this slice is that the pipeline already exists. The three classes are (a) frozen comparand, patterns.md:903, an oracle comparing against a literal integer read off main with no live git show main:<path> or equivalent re-derivation token present in the same criterion; (b) rotating-artifact target, patterns.md:907, an oracle whose asserted-against path is a per-story rotating harness state file, where the target set is a fixed literal list covering scripts/cam/handoff.json and the reviewer's gitignored capture-pane artifact; (c) zero-match-vacuous, patterns.md:901, the unguarded empty-$L sed anchor shape and the while-read loop fed by grep -n, both of which pass vacuously on zero matches. Preserve the module's declared purity contract at the top of prd-oracle-lint.ts: the walk performs no I/O and never reads a file itself, so every rule must be decidable from the criterion string alone. WORK 2, prose mirror: append the :899 red-on-main falsifiability rule to the auditor's existing acceptance-criteria checklist item that already carries the CAM-310 oracle rules, in BOTH .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md. That item is content-identical across the two copies today and must remain so. The falsifiability rule is deliberately prose rather than a lint rule because executing a candidate oracle against main requires shell plus a worktree, which would break the lint module's no-I/O contract; record that reasoning in the issue trail rather than silently omitting the rule.
acceptanceCriteria: The RULES array in src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts gains exactly three new rules, one per class (frozen-comparand, rotating-artifact-target, zero-match-vacuous). [oracle: named-command] The rule count is asserted by DERIVING both sides live rather than freezing either: compare the RULES entry count on the branch against the count obtained from `git show main:src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts` and assert the branch exceeds main by exactly 3. Do NOT write a literal expected total.

Each of the three new rules is proven falsifiable by a unit test that feeds it a criterion string exhibiting the defect and asserts a finding is produced, AND a sibling test feeding the corrected form of that same string asserting no finding. [oracle: named-command] `bun test test/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts` (or the existing test file for this module, located by grep rather than assumed) passes with both directions present for all three rules.

The frozen-comparand rule does not fire on a criterion that derives its comparand live. [oracle: named-command] A unit test feeds a criterion containing a `git show main:` derivation alongside an integer and asserts zero findings, pinning the rule against the obvious false-positive.

src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts still performs no I/O: no fs, no Bun.file, no spawn, no git invocation is introduced into the module. [oracle: file-assert] The module's import list and body contain no filesystem or subprocess call; verify by inspecting the diff of that file, not by a whole-file string prohibition that could be tripped by a comment legitimately DOCUMENTING the no-I/O contract.

No new verdict string, no new terminal kind, and no change to TERMINAL_VERDICTS in src/supervisor/decide.ts. [oracle: named-command] `git diff main -- src/supervisor/decide.ts src/supervisor/review.ts` is empty.

The red-on-main falsifiability rule from patterns.md:899 is appended to the auditor's acceptance-criteria checklist item that already carries the CAM-310 self-nullifying-oracle rule, in BOTH .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md. [oracle: named-command] The added text is byte-identical between the two copies; verify by extracting that checklist item from each file by CONTENT anchor (grep for the oracle-kinds line) rather than by line number, and diffing the two extractions.

Full quality spine green: `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run check:all`, and `bun run embed-vendor:check` (templates/ changed, so the embedded copy must be regenerated via `bun run embed-vendor` and committed). [oracle: named-command]

Test count does not regress. [oracle: named-command] Derive main's pass count via a run against `git show main:` state or the recorded baseline and assert the branch's pass count is greater than or equal to it, deriving both sides rather than freezing either integer.
gotchas: EAT THE DOG FOOD: this PRD's own acceptance criteria are subject to the very three rules it enforces. Every comparand above must be derived, not frozen; no criterion may target scripts/cam/handoff.json or any per-story rotating artifact; no criterion may be a whole-file string prohibition that re-reddens when a fix story correctly documents the removed thing. Last cycle five of nine criteria were defective in exactly these ways and burned all three review rounds.

Sweep every oracle RED against an unmodified main tree before dispatch, exhaustively, not by sample. A green-on-main oracle is legitimate ONLY when explicitly labelled a pinning/invariance guard. Sweeping is necessary but NOT sufficient: an oracle red today can still rot as later stories legitimately change the file, which is why the derive-don't-freeze rule applies to the instrument as well as the deliverable.

templates/ is embedded into the binary at build time via src/vendor/_generated.ts, so WORK 2 requires `bun run embed-vendor` plus a binary rebuild to take effect. .claude/agents/*.md is read from disk at spawn and needs NO rebuild on its own. src/ changes in WORK 1 also require a rebuild.

.claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md DIFFER overall (three deliberate cam-cli specialization hunks: dependency-ordering tiers, Ink/terminal-only verification versus generic browser+E2E, and the invariants section). Do NOT reconcile those differences. Only the acceptance-criteria checklist item carrying the oracle rules is content-identical, and only that item is in scope. Anchor edits by content, since the item sits at a different line number in each file.

CAM-379 (open, stage:idea) also edits subagent-auditor.md in both copies, adding the merit-over-cost rule to a different section. Low collision risk but real: if CAM-379 ships first, re-derive line anchors before editing.

The red-on-main sweep rule (patterns.md:899) is deliberately NOT a lint rule. Executing candidate oracles needs shell plus a worktree and would break prd-oracle-lint.ts's stated pure/no-I/O contract. This is an accepted structural limit, not an oversight, and must not be quietly 'fixed' by adding I/O to that module.
prd-oracle-lint.ts parses criteria via parseOracleDirectives in the behavioral-gate module; reuse that existing parse rather than writing a second criterion parser.
domainTerms: OracleLintRule: a pure predicate in src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts's RULES array, applied to each acceptance-criterion string at plan time; findings are folded into a synthetic audit BLOCK that drives the bounded replan loop.

Frozen comparand: an oracle right-hand side captured as a literal integer during authoring instead of re-derived live from main at check time; it rots silently when any later commit edits the same file.
Rotating artifact: a per-story harness state file (notably scripts/cam/handoff.json) that is overwritten every story, so an oracle targeting it passes only transiently and reads red at branch HEAD.

Zero-match-vacuous oracle: a shell oracle that degrades to an unconditional pass when its anchor or match set is empty, such as an unguarded empty sed range or a while-read loop over zero grep matches.

Red-on-main sweep: proving an oracle CAN fail by running it against unmodified main before trusting it; distinct from derive-don't-freeze, which governs how the comparison's right-hand side is obtained.
